{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the 'severity' column values again
print("Values in 'severity' column:")
print(trial_df['severity'].value_counts())

# Check the 'severity' column for any inconsistencies
print("Unique values in 'severity':", trial_df['severity'].unique())

# Check for case sensitivity or whitespace issues
print("Values after stripping and uppercasing:")
print(trial_df['severity'].str.strip().str.upper().value_counts())

# Check the full dataset for SEVERE patients
severe_patients_raw = trial_df[trial_df['severity'].str.strip().str.upper() == 'SEVERE']
print("Number of SEVERE patients after cleaning case and whitespace:", len(severe_patients_raw))

# Check the biomarker_baseline values for these patients
print("First 10 biomarker_baseline values for SEVERE patients:")
print(severe_patients_raw['biomarker_baseline'].head(10))"}
